thoracic-surgery-he-jie.title: Academician, Chinese Academy of Sciences
thoracic-surgery-he-jie.authority: Academician of the Chinese Academy of Sciences; director of the National Cancer Center; president of the Cancer Hospital, Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences; an authority on thoracic surgery and lung/oesophageal cancer surgery in China.
thoracic-surgery-he-jie.focus: Minimally invasive surgery and integrated treatment for lung cancer, oesophageal cancer and mediastinal tumours; standardisation of thoracic oncology care.
thoracic-surgery-he-jie.achievement: Led the establishment of the National Cancer Center and the national cancer registry system; advanced early lung cancer screening and standardised minimally invasive oesophageal cancer surgery.
thoracic-surgery-he-jie.honors: National Science and Technology Progress Award (First Class); Ho Leung Ho Lee Foundation Science and Technology Progress Award.

thoracic-surgery-wang-jun.title: Academician, Chinese Academy of Engineering
thoracic-surgery-wang-jun.achievement: Founded China's thoracoscopic minimally invasive thoracic surgery system and popularised minimally invasive lung cancer surgery.
thoracic-surgery-wang-jun.honors: Research on standardising thoracoscopic minimally invasive surgery.

obstetrics-gynecology-lang-jing-he.title: Academician, Chinese Academy of Engineering
obstetrics-gynecology-lang-jing-he.authority: Academician of the Chinese Academy of Engineering; former chair of the Chinese Society of Obstetrics and Gynaecology; an authority on gynaecological oncology, endometriosis and minimally invasive gynaecology in China.

obstetrics-gynecology-lang-jing-he.achievement: Promoted the uptake of laparoscopic and minimally invasive techniques in Chinese gynaecology and led the drafting of guidelines including those for endometriosis.
obstetrics-gynecology-lang-jing-he.honors: National Science and Technology Progress Award (Second Class); Ho Leung Ho Lee Foundation Science and Technology Progress Award.

ophthalmology-wang-ning-li.title: Academician, Chinese Academy of Engineering; Academician, International Council of Ophthalmology
ophthalmology-wang-ning-li.authority: Academician of the Chinese Academy of Engineering; director of the Eye Centre at Beijing Tongren Hospital; dean of the Capital Medical University School of Ophthalmology; former chair of the Chinese Ophthalmological Society; the only mainland Chinese scholar to have chaired both the World Glaucoma Association and the Asia-Pacific Academy of Ophthalmology.

dermatology-jin-hong-zhong.title: Chief physician, professor, doctoral supervisor
